title: Move the Defender
setup: Black's king already attacks the rook on b5, and the white king on c4 is the only thing defending it.
hint: The rook is defended exactly once. Find the check that sends that defender away and leaves your own rook safe.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rg4+}} pushes the defender off: after {{Kc3}} {{Kxb5}}, the c-pawn falls as well and Black is a rook up. The natural {{Rc2+}} chases the king too, but after {{Kb3}} it attacks your rook, and the rooks come off into a dead draw.
